content: Appendix H: Multi-seed policy-level loss and comparison ledger

This appendix reports 168 matched policy-hour records (no control and greedy/arbiter seeds 42–44). The magnitude and sign of each delta refer to the same-hour no-control AC result. The complete study includes both positive and negative deviations. A 24-hour window cannot substantiate general annual performance.
